rows.text: For the last four days water to our building (Sai Krupa Apartments, 3rd Cross, Vidyaranyapura) comes only about ten minutes in the morning and pressure is so low it never reaches the overhead tank, the buildings on either side are getting normal supply so something is wrong with our valve
rows.summary: Building receiving water for only 10 minutes daily at low pressure failing to reach the overhead tank for the past four days.
rows.note: PAIR 1A - piped drinking water pressure, one building, alternate arrangement still possible, so medium.

rows.text: No water at all in our whole street for 6 days now, 2nd Cross Vidyaranyapura, roughly 40 houses. We are buying tanker water at Rs 1200 a trip and half the families here cannot afford that. Nobody at the sub division office picks up the phone.
rows.summary: Complete lack of water supply for 40 houses on 2nd Cross Vidyaranyapura for 6 days.
rows.note: PAIR 1B - same service, but total outage across ~40 households for six days, so high.

rows.text: bhai ye manhole ka dhakkan pichle 2 din se gayab hai, MG road ke peeche wali gali me, raat ko bilkul dikhta nahi aur bacche wahi cricket khelte hai, koi andar gir gaya to jaan chali jayegi, please aaj hi cover lagwao
rows.summary: Missing manhole cover in a lane behind MG Road where children play cricket.
rows.note: PAIR 2A - open manhole, cover absent, children playing over it: fall into a sewer chamber kills, so critical.

rows.text: usi gali me ek aur manhole hai jiska dhakkan laga hua hai lekin crack hai, gaadi upar se jaati hai to khadakta hai aur awaaz aati hai, abhi koi girne wala khatra nahi hai but replace kar dijiye warna baad me tut jayega
rows.summary: Cracked manhole cover rattling under vehicles, needs replacement before failure.
rows.note: PAIR 2B - same chamber type, cover present though cracked, nobody exposed, so a scheduled replacement at medium.

rows.text: सड़क पर पिछले तीन दिन से पीने के पानी की पाइपलाइन फूटी पड़ी है, साफ पानी लगातार बहकर बर्बाद हो रहा है और उसी वजह से पूरी कॉलोनी में प्रेशर आधा हो गया है, कृपया जल्दी ठीक करवाइए
rows.summary: Broken drinking water pipeline causing continuous wastage and halved water pressure across the colony for three days.
rows.note: PAIR 3A - the water on the road is treated drinking water from a main, so water supply owns the repair; colony wide loss makes it high.

rows.text: सड़क पर पिछले तीन दिन से पीने के पानी की पाइपलाइन फूटी पड़ी है, साफ पानी लगातार बहकर बर्बाद हो रहा है और उसी वजह से पूरी कॉलोनी में प्रेशर आधा हो गया है, कृपया जल्दी ठीक करवाइए
rows.summary: Broken drinking water pipeline wasting clean water and halving pressure across the colony for three days.
rows.note: PAIR 3A - the water on the road is treated drinking water from a main, so water supply owns the repair; colony wide loss makes it high.

rows.text: उसी जगह पर अब गंदा नाली का पानी सड़क पर बह रहा है, बदबू के मारे वहाँ खड़ा नहीं हुआ जाता, बच्चे स्कूल जाते समय उसी पानी में से निकलते हैं, कृपया चैंबर साफ करवाइए
rows.summary: Dirty drain water flowing onto the road where school children wade through it.
rows.note: PAIR 3B - identical picture of water across the road, but it is sewage, so drainage does the repair; urgency held at high.

rows.text: ನಮ್ಮ ಬಡಾವಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ದಿನದಿಂದ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಇಡೀ ಕರೆಂಟ್ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಫ್ಯಾನ್ ಲೈಟ್ ಏನೂ ಬರುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಬೀದಿ ದೀಪಗಳೂ ಉರಿಯುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸ್‌ಫಾರ್ಮರ್ ಹಾಳಾಗಿದೆ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳ್ತಾರೆ ಸರಿ ಮಾಡಿಸಿ
rows.summary: Locality-wide power and streetlight outage for the past three days due to a damaged transformer.
rows.note: PAIR 4A - houses are dark too, so the fault is upstream supply, not the lighting circuit; whole layout for 3 nights is high.

rows.text: ನಮ್ಮ ಬೀದಿಯ ಮನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಕರೆಂಟ್ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಬರುತ್ತಿದೆ ಆದರೆ ರಸ್ತೆ ದೀಪಗಳು ಮಾತ್ರ ಹತ್ತು ದಿನದಿಂದ ಉರಿಯುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಇಡೀ ರಸ್ತೆ ಕತ್ತಲು, ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಬರೋಕೆ ಭಯ ಪಡ್ತಾರೆ
rows.summary: Streetlights non-functional for ten days leaving the entire street in darkness at night.
rows.note: PAIR 4B - domestic power is fine, so only the street lighting circuit has failed; a fully dark street for ten days is high.

rows.text: எங்க தெருவுல ரெண்டு நாளா குப்பை வண்டி வரலை, வீட்டு முன்னாடி கவர்ல கட்டி வெச்சிருக்கோம், கொஞ்சம் நாத்தம் அடிக்குது, தயவுசெஞ்சு வண்டிய அனுப்புங்க
rows.summary: Garbage collection vehicle missed for two days; waste kept in covers with slight odor.
rows.note: PAIR 5A - two missed collection days on one street, bagged waste, contained nuisance, so medium.

rows.text: எங்க தெருவுல மூணு வாரமா குப்பை வண்டியே வரவே இல்ல, மூலையில குப்பை மலை மாதிரி சேர்ந்து சாலையில பாதி அடைச்சிடுச்சு, நாய் எலி புழு எல்லாம் இருக்கு, தெருவுல நாலஞ்சு குழந்தைகளுக்கு வாந்தி பேதி வந்திருக்கு
rows.summary: Garbage uncollected for three weeks piled up and blocking half the street, causing pest infestation and children falling ill.
rows.note: PAIR 5B - same missed collection but three weeks, blocking the carriageway with illness already appearing, so high.

rows.text: బస్ స్టాండ్ దగ్గర ఉన్న పబ్లిక్ టాయిలెట్ వారం రోజులుగా శుభ్రం చేయలేదు, లోపలికి వెళ్లలేని పరిస్థితి, మలం అంతా పేరుకుపోయి ఉంది, రోజూ వందల మంది వాడతారు దయచేసి క్లీన్ చేయించండి
rows.summary: High-footfall public toilet uncleaned for a week with accumulated faeces, rendering it completely unusable.
rows.note: PAIR 6A - the failure is the cleaning contract for a public facility, so sanitation; a high footfall toilet unusable for a week is high.

rows.text: అదే బస్ స్టాండ్ టాయిలెట్‌లో పది రోజులుగా ట్యాప్‌లో చుక్క నీరు రావట్లేదు, అందుకే ఎవరూ ఫ్లష్ చేయలేకపోతున్నారు, స్వీపర్ వస్తున్నాడు కానీ నీళ్లు లేకుండా ఏం చేస్తాడు, వాటర్ కనెక్షన్ చూడండి
rows.summary: No water supply to the bus stand toilet taps and flush for the last ten days.
rows.note: PAIR 6B - same toilet, same state, but the root cause named is a dead water connection, so water supply does the repair; urgency held at high.

rows.text: আমাদের পাড়ার রাস্তায় একটা বড় গর্ত হয়েছে, গাড়িগুলো আস্তে আস্তে পাশ কাটিয়ে যায়, বৃষ্টি হলে জল জমে গর্তটা কোথায় বোঝাই যায় না, দয়া করে মেরামত করে দিন
rows.summary: Large pothole on neighborhood street fills with rainwater, becoming hidden and hazardous.
rows.note: PAIR 7A - carriageway pothole on a residential road, traffic is coping, nobody hurt, so medium.

rows.text: ওই একই রাস্তার গর্তটা এখন অনেক বড় হয়ে গেছে, গত এক সপ্তাহে তিনজন বাইক আরোহী ওখানে পড়ে গিয়ে হাসপাতালে গেছে, একজনের হাত ভেঙেছে, রাতে কিছুই দেখা যায় না, এক্ষুনি কিছু করুন
rows.summary: Large pothole causing multiple bike crashes and a broken arm over the past week.
rows.note: PAIR 7B - same pothole, but it has already put three riders in hospital and is invisible at night, so critical.

rows.text: आमच्या भागातील उद्यानातील मोठ्या झाडाची फांदी तुटून लोंबकळत आहे, त्याच्या खाली मुलं खेळतात आणि बाकावर वयस्कर लोक बसतात, वारा आला की कधीही पडू शकते, कृपया लवकर कापून टाका
rows.summary: Large broken tree branch hanging in the park where children play and elders sit.
rows.note: PAIR 8A - tree work inside a park is horticulture's, and a hanging broken limb over occupied seating is high.

rows.text: त्याच उद्यानातील झाडांची खूप दिवसांपासून छाटणी झालेली नाही, वाळलेली पानं खाली पडून राहतात आणि बघायला अस्वच्छ वाटतं, वेळ मिळेल तेव्हा ट्रिमिंग करून घ्या
rows.summary: Unpruned trees and fallen dry leaves making the park look untidy.
rows.note: PAIR 8B - same trees, same park, but routine overdue pruning with nothing overhead about to fall, so low.

rows.text: There is an electric wire hanging loose from the pole outside gate no. 2 of Ramanna Layout and it has come down to about head height right over the footpath. Yesterday it sparked when an auto brushed past. Somebody is going to be electrocuted. This needs attention today itself.
rows.summary: Loose live wire hanging at head height over footpath outside gate no. 2, having recently sparked.
rows.note: Live conductor at head height on a footpath, already arcing: electrical assets, and lethal within days, so critical.

rows.text: The streetlight in front of house no. 47, 6th Main, Kalyan Nagar has been blinking on and off the whole night for around two weeks. It is not fully dark on the road but the flickering is very disturbing and I think the fitting or the driver is faulty.
rows.summary: Streetlight blinking on and off at night for two weeks in Kalyan Nagar.
rows.location_text: in front of house no. 47, 6th Main, Kalyan Nagar
rows.note: Single faulty luminaire with the road still lit and no dark patch created - a routine replacement, so low (same rung as case 55).

rows.text: There are about twelve stray dogs sitting near the Anand Nagar community hall and they chase two wheelers every evening. My mother is now scared to walk to the temple. I know this may not be your department but nobody else picks up the phone.
rows.summary: Stray dogs chasing two-wheelers near Anand Nagar community hall, causing residents fear and restricting access.
rows.note: Stray dog control sits with the corporation's veterinary/animal birth control wing, none of the eight service departments, so other; chasing without a bite yet is medium.

rows.text: The wall of the pump house at the corner of 12th Cross and Palace Road, exactly opposite Sri Lakshmi Medicals, is completely covered with old film posters and paan stains. It looks very bad on a main road. Please get it cleaned and painted whenever it is possible.
rows.summary: Pump house wall covered in posters and paan stains needing cleaning and painting.
rows.location_text: corner of 12th Cross and Palace Road, opposite Sri Lakshmi Medicals
rows.note: Defacement removal on a public structure is sanitation's beautification work; precise landmark but purely cosmetic, so low.

rows.text: sach me thak gaya hu ab, roz subah darwaza kholta hu wahi kachra pada rehta hai koi uthane nahi aata, 10 saal se tax bhar raha hu, jo karna hai kar lo
rows.summary: Uncollected household garbage piling up daily outside the door.
rows.note: Barely a complaint - no address, no date, no quantity - but the only actionable noun is uncollected waste, so garbage at low until someone calls him back.

rows.text: The footpath slab outside 14 Church Street has broken and there is now a gap nearly two feet wide going straight down into the drain below. An elderly gentleman almost stepped into it last evening. The drain underneath is also choked and needs cleaning but first please close the gap.
rows.summary: Broken footpath slab opening into a drain, with a near-miss injury last evening.
rows.note: Two departments are involved but the physical repair is casting and setting a footpath slab, which is roads; a person-sized hole on a busy footpath is high.

rows.text: hamare gali ki naali ke upar thoda kachra jam gaya hai, paani nikal to raha hai bas thoda slow, jab time mile tab saaf kara dena, koi emergency nahi hai
rows.summary: Drain on the street has minor garbage buildup causing slow water flow.
rows.note: Partial silting in an open drain that is still flowing, complainant himself says it can wait, so low.

rows.text: pichle 15 din se voltage bahut low aa raha hai, sham 7 baje ke baad fridge aur paani ki motor chalu hi nahi hoti, bulb bhi dim jalta hai, poore block me sabki yahi shikayat hai
rows.summary: Low voltage issue across the entire block every evening for the past 15 days, preventing appliances from running.
rows.note: Distribution side voltage problem, so electricity; a fortnight of evening inconvenience without danger reads medium.

rows.text: AAP LOG KUCH KAAM KARTE HI NAHI HO!!! HAMARI GALI KE NUKKAD PE JO CORPORATION KA BOARD LAGA HAI USPE WARD NUMBER HI GALAT LIKHA HAI, 3 SAAL SE GALAT HAI, KITNI BAAR BOLA, SAB NIKAMME LOG BAITHE HO, TAX LENE KE TIME SAB THEEK RAHTA HAI
rows.summary: Incorrect ward number displayed on the corporation board at the lane corner.
rows.note: Furious in tone but the defect is a wrong number on a signage board - administrative, not a service department, so other at low.

rows.text: पार्क के मुख्य गेट का ताला टूट गया है और रात में लड़के अंदर आकर शराब पीते हैं, सुबह बोतलें और गिलास पड़े रहते हैं, गेट ठीक करवाइए और शाम को बंद करने के लिए किसी को लगाइए
rows.summary: Park main gate lock is broken, leading to unauthorized night entry and littering.
rows.note: Park gate hardware and park closing duty both sit with parks; misuse at night is a real problem but nobody is at risk, so medium.

rows.text: बारिश के बाद हमारे मोहल्ले की नाली उफन गई है और गली में डेढ़ फुट पानी भरा है, उसी पानी में बिजली का खंभा खड़ा है जिसमें से कल चिंगारी निकल रही थी, कोई भी करंट लगकर मर सकता है, तुरंत आइए
rows.summary: Electric pole sparking in one and a half feet of floodwater after rain.
rows.note: Two departments, but the physical intervention that stops a death is isolating and repairing the arcing pole, which is electricity; flooded live pole is critical.

rows.text: हमारी गली में कूड़ा गाड़ी सुबह छह बजे आती है जब सब सो रहे होते हैं, हॉर्न बजाकर दो मिनट में चली जाती है, कोई निकल ही नहीं पाता इसलिए लोग बगल के खाली प्लॉट में कूड़ा फेंकने लगे हैं, समय बदलिए
rows.summary: Garbage collection truck arrives too early and leaves quickly, leading to illegal dumping in a vacant plot.
rows.note: Door to door collection timing is the garbage wing's to fix, and it is already producing a dumping spot, so medium rather than low.

rows.text: हमारी गली के खंभे पर लगी नई लाइट सीधे मेरे बेडरूम की खिड़की में पड़ती है, रात भर कमरे में उजाला रहता है और नींद नहीं आती, अगर हो सके तो उस तरफ शेड लगा दीजिए
rows.summary: New street light shines directly into a bedroom window, causing sleep disruption.
rows.note: Light trespass from a working street light - streetlights owns the fitting, and it is a single household comfort issue, so low.

rows.text: ನಮ್ಮ ವಾರ್ಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ನೀರು ಮೂರು ದಿನದಿಂದ ಕೆಟ್ಟ ವಾಸನೆ ಬರುತ್ತಿದೆ, ಬಣ್ಣ ಕೂಡ ಹಳದಿ ಇದೆ, ಒಳಚರಂಡಿ ನೀರು ಬೆರೆತಿದೆ ಅನ್ನಿಸುತ್ತೆ, ನಮ್ಮ ಬೀದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಎಂಟು ಜನಕ್ಕೆ ವಾಂತಿ ಭೇದಿ ಆಗಿದೆ, ಒಂದು ಮಗು ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ
rows.summary: Tap water is yellow and foul-smelling with sewage mixing, causing vomiting and hospitalization in the area.
rows.note: Contamination of the drinking main is water supply's to trace and isolate; eight sick and a child admitted makes it critical.

rows.text: ನಮ್ಮ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯ ಹಿಂಭಾಗದ ರಸ್ತೆಗೆ ಕಸ ಗುಡಿಸುವವರು ಎರಡು ವಾರದಿಂದ ಬಂದೇ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಎಲೆ ಧೂಳು ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಟಿಕ್ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಬಿದ್ದಿದೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಸ್ವೀಪಿಂಗ್ ಮಾಡಿಸಿ
rows.summary: Street sweepers haven't visited behind the market for two weeks, leaving litter scattered.
rows.note: Street sweeping beat not being served is sanitation, distinct from bin collection; two weeks behind a market is medium.

rows.text: ನಮ್ಮ ಬಡಾವಣೆಯ ಒಳರಸ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಡಾಂಬರು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸವೆದಿದೆ, ಗುಂಡಿ ಏನೂ ಬಿದ್ದಿಲ್ಲ ಆದರೆ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಒರಟಾಗಿದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಜಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಂದಿದೆ, ಮುಂದಿನ ವರ್ಷದ ರಿ-ಟಾರಿಂಗ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ
rows.summary: Asphalt worn down with rough surface and gravel on the inner layout road.
rows.note: Surface wear with no pothole, and the citizen is asking to be put on next year's list, so roads at low.

rows.text: ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಜನರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕಾಳಜಿಯೇ ಇಲ್ಲ, ನಮ್ಮ ಏರಿಯಾ ಪೂರ್ತಿ ಹಾಳಾಗಿ ಹೋಗಿದೆ, ಮೊದಲಿನ ಥರ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ
rows.summary: Vague complaint about the area deteriorating with no specific issue stated.
rows.note: No service, no location, no defect named - nothing any department can dispatch on, so other at low pending a callback.

rows.text: எங்க ஏரியால கால்வாய் ஓரமா யாரோ ராத்திரி லாரியில கட்டிட கழிவு செங்கல் உடைசல் எல்லாம் கொட்டிட்டு போயிட்டாங்க, இப்போ சாலையில பாதி அடைச்சிடுச்சு, பஸ் திரும்ப முடியாம நிக்குது
rows.summary: Construction waste dumped by lorry blocking half the road near the canal and trapping buses.
rows.note: Construction and demolition waste lifting is the solid waste wing's job; a heap blocking half a bus route is high.

rows.text: எங்க தெருவுல இருக்குற தெருவிளக்கு கம்பம் அடிப்பாகத்துல முழுசா துருப்பிடிச்சு சாஞ்சிருக்கு, நேத்து காத்துல ஆடுச்சு, அதுக்கு கீழதான் ஸ்கூல் வேன் தினமும் நிக்கும் இடம், எப்ப வேணும்னாலும் விழலாம் உடனே பாருங்க
rows.summary: Rusted and tilted electricity pole swaying in the wind above a school van parking spot.
rows.location_text: our street, where the school van parks
rows.note: The asset is a street lighting pole, so streetlights; corroded at the base, already swaying, over a school pickup point - critical.

rows.text: மழை பெஞ்சா எங்க தெரு முனையில தண்ணி ரெண்டு நாள் வரைக்கும் தேங்கி நிக்குது, கொசு உற்பத்தி ஆகுது, மழைநீர் வடிகால் அடைச்சிருக்கு போல இருக்கு, ஒரு தடவை சுத்தம் பண்ணுங்க
rows.summary: Stormwater drain blocked causing two-day water stagnation and mosquito breeding after rain.
rows.note: Storm water drain desilting; localised ponding after rain with a mosquito nuisance but no entry into homes, so medium.

rows.text: எங்க பூங்கா நுழைவு வாயில்ல இருக்குற பெயர் பலகையில எழுத்து எல்லாம் மங்கி போயிடுச்சு, படிக்கவே முடியலை, ஒரு பெயிண்ட் அடிச்சா நல்லா இருக்கும்
rows.summary: Park entrance name board letters have faded and need repainting.
rows.note: Faded name board on a park gate - parks owns it, and it is cosmetic, so low.

rows.text: మా వీధిలో పబ్లిక్ ట్యాప్ దగ్గర కుళాయి పగిలిపోయి రోజంతా నీళ్లు వృథాగా పోతున్నాయి, పక్కనే గుంత అయిపోయి బురద నిలుస్తోంది, రెండు వారాలుగా ఇలాగే ఉంది, రిపేర్ చేయించండి
rows.summary: Broken pipe near public tap leaking water and forming a stagnant mud pit for two weeks.
rows.location_text: near the public tap on our street
rows.note: Broken public stand post is water supply plumbing; continuous wastage is a real repair but nobody is at risk, so medium.

rows.text: మా కాలనీలో ట్రాన్స్‌ఫార్మర్ చుట్టూ ఉన్న ఫెన్సింగ్ ఊడిపోయి నెల రోజులైంది, పిల్లలు దాని పక్కనే ఆడుకుంటున్నారు, ఇంకా ఏమీ జరగలేదు కానీ వెంటనే ఫెన్సింగ్ వేయించండి
rows.summary: Transformer fencing missing for a month with children playing nearby.
rows.note: Transformer enclosure is electricity's asset; open access next to a children's play area for a month is high.

rows.text: పక్కింటి వాళ్ల సెప్టిక్ ట్యాంక్ నిండిపోయి మురుగు మా వీధిలోకి రోడ్డు మీదకి పారుతోంది, వాళ్లేమో ఇది మా సొంత విషయం అంటున్నారు, కానీ మురుగు అంతా పబ్లిక్ రోడ్డు మీద నిలుస్తోంది
rows.summary: Neighbor's septic tank overflowed, stagnating sewage on the public road.
rows.note: Private septic overflow, but sewage standing on a public road is drainage's to flush; one lane, one source, so medium.

rows.text: మా ఏరియాలో బస్ షెల్టర్ లో దుమ్ము, పాత పోస్టర్లు అన్నీ పేరుకుపోయాయి, కూర్చోవడానికి ఇబ్బందిగా ఉంది, ఒకసారి క్లీన్ చేయించండి
rows.summary: Bus shelter needs cleaning due to accumulated dust and old posters.
rows.note: Cleaning a public shelter is sanitation; dust and old posters are routine housekeeping, so low.

rows.text: আমাদের গলির মুখে কেবল লাইন বসানোর জন্য রাস্তা খোঁড়া হয়েছিল, কাজ শেষ হয়ে গেছে অনেকদিন কিন্তু মাটি ঠিকমতো ভরাট করে দেয়নি, পুরো জায়গাটা এবড়োখেবড়ো হয়ে আছে, সাইকেল নিয়ে যেতে খুব অসুবিধা হয়
rows.summary: Lane entrance road left uneven after cable work, making bicycle travel difficult.
rows.note: Unrestored road cut - reinstating the surface is the roads wing's work regardless of who dug it; uneven but passable, so medium.

rows.text: আমাদের পাড়ার ভ্যাটটা এত ছোট যে বেশিরভাগ আবর্জনা বাইরেই পড়ে থাকে, গরু আর কুকুর টেনে চারদিকে ছড়িয়ে দেয়, একটা বড় কম্প্যাক্টর বিন বসালে খুব ভালো হয়
rows.summary: Neighborhood garbage vat is too small, causing waste to spill out and scatter by animals.
rows.note: Undersized collection point is the solid waste wing's asset planning; a persistent spillover problem, so medium.

rows.text: স্টেশন রোডের মোড় থেকে স্কুল পর্যন্ত সাতটা আলোর মধ্যে পাঁচটাই জ্বলে না, প্রায় এক মাস ধরে এই অবস্থা, সন্ধ্যের পর ওই রাস্তায় হাঁটতে সত্যিই ভয় লাগে
rows.summary: Five out of seven streetlights non-functional for a month between the station road crossing and the school.
rows.location_text: from station road crossing up to the school
rows.note: Most of a lit stretch dark for a month on a school approach affects many people nightly, so streetlights at high.

rows.text: গত দশ দিন ধরে দিনে চার পাঁচ বার করে বিদ্যুৎ চলে যাচ্ছে, প্রতিবার আধ ঘণ্টা মতো, পাড়ার সব দোকানে ফ্রিজের মাল নষ্ট হয়ে যাচ্ছে, মিস্ত্রি বলল ট্রান্সফরমারে লোড অনেক বেশি পড়ছে
rows.summary: Frequent daily power outages over ten days overloading transformer and spoiling shop refrigerators.
rows.note: Repeated tripping from an overloaded transformer is electricity's; supply keeps returning, so it sits with the other degraded-supply cases at medium rather than with the total-outage cases at high.

rows.text: এই পৌরসভা একেবারে অপদার্থ!! আমাদের গলির নামের ফলকটা উল্টো করে লাগানো হয়েছে, তিন বছর ধরে বলে যাচ্ছি, কেউ কানে তোলে না, সব কটা অকর্মণ্য, ট্যাক্স নেওয়ার সময় তো ঠিক সময়ে চলে আসে
rows.summary: Alley nameplate installed upside down.
rows.note: Abusive in tone, but a street name plate fixed the wrong way round is estate/signage work and harms nobody, so other at low.

rows.text: आमच्या गल्लीत रस्त्याच्या कडेला असलेला पेव्हर ब्लॉकचा फुटपाथ अनेक ठिकाणी उखडला आहे, ब्लॉक सुटे झाले आहेत आणि चालताना पायाखाली हलतात, अजून कोणी पडलेलं नाही पण दुरुस्ती करा
rows.summary: Uprooted and loose paver blocks on the roadside footpath causing wobble underfoot.
rows.note: Footpath surface is roads; loose pavers are a genuine trip hazard but no hole and no injury yet, so medium.

rows.text: आमच्या भागातील सार्वजनिक शौचालयाच्या भिंतीवर पान खाऊन थुंकल्याचे डाग आहेत आणि दरवाजा खूप जुना झाला आहे, स्वच्छता तर रोज होते पण रंगरंगोटी केली तर बरे होईल
rows.summary: Betel leaf stains on the walls and an old door at the local public toilet needing repainting.
rows.note: The facility is being cleaned; only appearance is at issue, so sanitation at low.

rows.text: आमच्या उद्यानातील पाण्याचा कारंजा गेली दोन वर्षे बंद आहे, आता त्यात फक्त कोरडी माती आणि पालापाचोळा आहे, सुरू करता आले तर बघा नाहीतर तिथे झाडे लावा
rows.summary: Park water fountain non-functional for two years, filled with dry soil and leaves.
rows.note: Disused park amenity, no risk, citizen offers an alternative - parks at low.

rows.text: आमच्या इमारतीच्या तळमजल्यावर एका दुकानदाराने परवानगी न घेता खानावळ सुरू केली आहे, रात्री उशिरापर्यंत मोठ्याने गाणी लावतात आणि तेलाचा वास येतो, ही तक्रार नक्की कोणाकडे करायची तेच कळत नाही
rows.summary: An unauthorized eatery has opened on the ground floor, causing noise and oil smell nuisances.
rows.note: Unlicensed eatery in a residential building falls to the trade licence / health nuisance wing, not any of the eight service departments, so other.

rows.text: The sewage connection at my house, 22 Nehru Colony, is blocked and dirty water backs up into the bathroom floor trap every time water is let out upstairs. Only our house has this, the rest of the lane is fine. Please send someone to rod the line.
rows.summary: Blocked sewage connection backing up into the bathroom floor trap at house 22.
rows.note: PAIR 9A - underground drainage blockage, but confined to one house connection, so medium.

rows.text: The sewer in Nehru Colony 2nd lane has been overflowing for five days, the entire lane is under dirty water and it has entered the ground floor of at least nine houses. Elderly people cannot step out of their gates. We have called four times already.
rows.summary: Overflowing sewer flooding Nehru Colony 2nd lane and nine homes for five days.
rows.note: PAIR 9B - same blockage type, but a whole lane and nine homes flooded with sewage for five days, so high.

rows.text: hamare corner pe bahut bura smell aa raha hai, kachre ka dher pada hua hai jo 4-5 din se uthaya nahi gaya, upar se log aur daal ke jaate hai, please uthwa dijiye
rows.summary: Pile of garbage uncollected for 4-5 days causing bad smell and attracting more waste at a street corner.
rows.note: PAIR 10A - identical smell complaint, but the source named is an uncollected waste heap, so garbage.

rows.text: hamare corner pe bahut bura smell aa raha hai, khuli naali me kaala paani ruka pada hai bilkul flow nahi ho raha, kachra to koi nahi daalta bas naali choke hai, saaf karwa dijiye
rows.summary: Stagnant black water in a choked open drain causing a severe bad odor at the corner.
rows.note: PAIR 10B - same smell, same corner, but the citizen rules out waste and points to a stagnant choked drain, so drainage.

rows.text: हमारी गली में एक स्ट्रीट लाइट पिछले हफ्ते से नहीं जल रही, बाकी चार लाइटें ठीक चल रही हैं इसलिए अंधेरा तो नहीं रहता, फिर भी बदल दीजिए
rows.summary: One streetlight not working for a week while other lights on the street function normally.
rows.note: PAIR 11A - one lamp out of five out, street still lit, so a routine replacement at low.

rows.text: रेलवे अंडरपास में जो अकेली लाइट है वो पिछले हफ्ते से नहीं जल रही, वहाँ और कोई रोशनी है ही नहीं, पिछले शुक्रवार को एक लड़की का बैग वहीं छीना गया, जल्दी ठीक कीजिए
rows.summary: Broken streetlight in unlit railway underpass where a robbery occurred last week.
rows.note: PAIR 11B - also a single lamp out for a week, but it is the only light in an underpass and a snatching has already happened there, so high.

rows.text: ಮಳೆ ಬಂದಾಗ ನಮ್ಮ ರಸ್ತೆಯ ತಿರುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ನಿಂತುಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಚರಂಡಿಯ ಬಾಯಿಗೆ ಮಣ್ಣು ಎಲೆ ತುಂಬಿಕೊಂಡಿದೆ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ನೀರು ಒಳಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಬಂದು ತೆಗೆಸಿ
rows.summary: Drain mouth choked with soil and leaves, causing water stagnation at the road turn when it rains.
rows.location_text: at the turn of our road
rows.note: PAIR 12A - identical ponding, but the citizen locates the fault at a blocked drain inlet, so drainage clears it.

rows.text: ಮಳೆ ಬಂದಾಗ ನಮ್ಮ ರಸ್ತೆಯ ತಿರುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ನಿಂತುಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಚರಂಡಿ ಸ್ವಚ್ಛವಾಗಿಯೇ ಇದೆ ಆದರೆ ಹೊಸ ಡಾಂಬರು ಹಾಕಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಮಧ್ಯಭಾಗ ತಗ್ಗಾಗಿ ನೀರು ಚರಂಡಿ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
rows.summary: Depressed road surface causes water accumulation during rain despite a clean drain.
rows.note: PAIR 12B - same ponding, but the drain is clear and the cause is lost camber after resurfacing, so roads must relevel.

rows.text: எங்க தெரு மூலையில இருக்குற மின் ஜங்ஷன் பாக்ஸ் கதவு உடைஞ்சு உள்ள வயர் எல்லாம் தெரியுது, பாக்ஸ் சுவத்துல ஆறடி உயரத்துல இருக்கு, யாருக்கும் இன்னும் ஒண்ணும் ஆகல, ஆனா மழை வர்றதுக்கு முன்னாடி சரி பண்ணுங்க
rows.summary: Electrical junction box door broken with visible wires at six-foot height before rains.
rows.note: PAIR 13A - open junction box with exposed wiring, but out of reach at six feet and nobody hurt, so high not critical.

rows.text: எங்க பள்ளிக்கூட வாசல் பக்கத்துல இருக்குற மின் ஜங்ஷன் பாக்ஸ் முழங்கால் உயரத்துல இருக்கு, கதவு உடைஞ்சு வயர் வெளிய தொங்குது, நேத்து ஒரு பையனுக்கு ஷாக் அடிச்சு கை வீங்கிடுச்சு, இன்னைக்கே வாங்க
rows.summary: Broken electrical junction box with exposed wires near school entrance; student already shocked.
rows.note: PAIR 13B - same open junction box, but at child height by a school gate and a boy has already been shocked, so critical.

rows.text: మా కాలనీ పార్క్ లోపల బయటి వాళ్లు రాత్రిపూట చెత్త వేసి పోతున్నారు, ఇప్పుడు లోపల మూడు నాలుగు కుప్పలు పేరుకుపోయాయి, ఆ చెత్తను ఎత్తించండి
rows.summary: Garbage heaps accumulated inside colony park due to illegal dumping by outsiders.
rows.note: PAIR 14A - the ask is lifting accumulated waste, which the solid waste wing does even inside a park.

rows.text: మా కాలనీ పార్క్ చుట్టూ ఉన్న కంచె ఒక వైపు పూర్తిగా విరిగిపోయింది, అందుకే బయటి వాళ్లు రాత్రిపూట లోపలికి వచ్చేస్తున్నారు, ఆ కంచెను బాగు చేయించండి
rows.summary: Colony park fence completely broken on one side, allowing outsiders to enter at night.
rows.note: PAIR 14B - same park, same nuisance, but the ask is repairing the park's own fencing, so parks.

rows.text: আমাদের রাস্তার ধারে পাইপ বসানোর জন্য একটা লম্বা খাল কাটা হয়েছে, দুপাশে ব্যারিকেড আর লাল ফিতে দেওয়া আছে, রাতে আলোও জ্বলে, কিন্তু দুই সপ্তাহ হয়ে গেল কেউ বুজিয়ে দিচ্ছে না
rows.summary: Trench dug for pipe-laying left unfilled for two weeks despite barricades and lights.
rows.note: PAIR 15A - open trench awaiting reinstatement, but properly barricaded and lit, so medium.

rows.text: আমাদের রাস্তার বাঁকের মুখে পাইপ বসানোর খাল কাটা হয়েছে কিন্তু কোনো ব্যারিকেড নেই, আলোও নেই, কাল রাতে একটা স্কুটি সোজা ওর মধ্যে পড়ে গেছে, ভাগ্যিস বেশি লাগেনি, আজই কিছু করুন
rows.summary: Unbarricaded trench dug for pipes at road turn caused a scooty crash last night.
rows.location_text: at the turn of our road
rows.note: PAIR 15B - same trench, but unbarricaded and unlit at a blind bend with a vehicle already in it, so critical.

rows.text: आमच्या वस्तीत गेल्या चार दिवसांपासून नळाला पाणीच येत नाही, टाकीतून आमच्या भागाकडे पाणी सोडलेच जात नाही असे बोलतात, जवळपास दोनशे कुटुंबे टँकरवर आहेत, लवकर बघा
rows.summary: Tap water supply has been cut off for four days across the locality, affecting around two hundred families.
rows.note: PAIR 16A - dry taps traced to the distribution schedule, so water supply; 200 households for four days is high.
